name: agent-workflow
description: Scott's Claude Code toolset: the agent-workflow flow runner plus general-purpose companion plugins.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: Three-layer flow runner: controller with human gates, maker sessions, fresh checker subagents; ticket identifier enforced by a tool.call mod.

plugins.name: context-usage-bar
plugins.description: Bars above the prompt: context window fill, rate-limit windows, and prompt-cache hit rate with an estimated TTL countdown; /cache-report summarizes hits, cliffs and idle gaps.

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps the session's prompt cache warm: one inert self-ping when idle approaches the TTL, so the next real turn reads the cache instead of rewriting it. Off by default; /keep-warm toggles per session.
